_instructions: Voice settings, read live. Limits and timeouts apply to the next dictation or reply; threads and pause_detection apply when a model next loads. idle_unload_minutes: free a model's memory after this long unused (0 keeps it loaded; the next use then waits a few seconds while it loads). dictation: max_concurrent dictations across all users; idle_capture_seconds before an abandoned dictation is dropped; finish_timeout_seconds to wait for the last phrase; max_recording_seconds per dictation; pause_detection closes a phrase after min_silence_seconds of silence (threshold = speech probability, phrases shorter than min_speech_seconds are ignored, unbroken speech is cut at max_phrase_seconds, and lead_in_seconds of audio before each phrase is included so a soft first word is kept). speech: max_chars of a reply read aloud; queue_wait_seconds a reply waits for the one before it.
